newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Rabobank Australia year profit rises.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Rabobank Australia year profit rises.

text.p: The Australian subsidiary of Rabobank Nederlands, Rabobank Australian Group, announced on Wednesday a 28 percent increase in pre-tax net profit to A$40.33 million from A$31.55 million.
Total revenues for the group rose to A$76.78 million from A$56.30 million while expenses rose to A$36.45 million from AS24.75 million.
Assets rose to A$4.37 billion from A$3.25 billion.
Group deputy chairman Cor Broekhuyse said the results demonstrated the growing strength of the group in its main rural and corporate agribusiness activities in Australasia.

He said the relatively rapid increase in costs reflected the many new products and services introduced since Rabobank purchased Australia's Primary Industry Bank and combined the two to form the Rabobank Australia Group.
The group said it was encouraged by the medium- and long-term outlook for the Australian and New Zealand agribusiness sector.
